name: Powercharged Shield: banish this -- target unit with taunt gains vigor
notes: Powercharged Shield's own activated ability requires a unit with taunt already on the field (activateAbilityPrereqs['rrii17fzcy:0']), so a Dungeon Guide is patched with TAUNT directly via test-setup rather than scripting a real taunt-granting effect.

rulesClauses: Banish Powercharged Shield: Target unit with taunt gains vigor until end of turn.
